title: Map: Operation SQUARE DEAL, 9 April 1960 U-2 overflight route
description: Map titled "Operation SQUARE DEAL, 9 April 1960" showing a U-2 flight path from Peshawar, Pakistan, north into the Kazakh S.S.R. to Semipalatinsk, looping past Sary Shagan and Lake Balkhash, west to Dzhezkazgan and Tyuratam, then south across the Uzbek and Turkmen S.S.R.s and Afghanistan to Zahedan, Iran. Neighboring China, India, Nepal and the disputed Jammu and Kashmir region are labeled; marked Secret NOFORN.
